
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/kybs0/p/20305667" title="发布于 2026-06-04 12:55">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET Win32设置只读未对齐，导致NTFS文件系统识别异常</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3>问题现象</h3>
<p>在Windows平台上，通过Win32 API <code>IOCTL_DISK_SET_DISK_ATTRIBUTES</code> 将磁盘设置为只读后，出现了意料之外的行为：磁盘属性面板显示已只读，但NTFS文件系统仍允许写入；或者反过来，磁盘已取消只读，但NTFS仍拒绝写入。这种"磁盘层"与"文件系统层"状态不一致的现象，在iSCSI磁盘热插拔场景下尤为突出——同一LUN路径上先后挂载不同磁盘，前一块盘的只读状态会"残留"给后一块盘。</p>
<p>表面上看，只读设置已经成功返回，<code>Get-Disk</code> 也确认为只读，但实际写入操作却不受控制。问题的根源在于Windows磁盘架构的分层设计。</p>
<h3>Windows磁盘只读的两层架构与刷新机制</h3>
<p>Windows的磁盘只读实际上分为两层：</p>
<ul>
<li>磁盘设备驱动层：通过 <code>IOCTL_DISK_SET_DISK_ATTRIBUTES</code> 设置，直接修改磁盘设备对象的属性。这一层是"物理级"的，一旦设置成功，所有对该磁盘设备的I/O请求都会被拦截。</li>
<li>NTFS文件系统驱动层：NTFS在内存中维护一个VCB（Volume Control Block）结构，缓存了磁盘的只读状态。文件系统的读写判断依赖的是VCB中的缓存值，而非实时去查询磁盘设备属性。</li>
</ul>
<p>关键问题在于：NTFS不会主动轮询磁盘属性的变化。当通过Win32 IOCTL修改了磁盘只读属性后，NTFS的VCB缓存仍然是旧值，直到某种事件触发它重新加载。</p>
<p>能触发NTFS重新加载磁盘属性的事件有四种：</p>
<div class="overflow-x-auto mb-[var(--chat-item-gap)] last:mb-0">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>触发方式</th><th>作用层级</th><th>副作用</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>磁盘Offline/Online</td>
<td>磁盘设备层</td>
<td>卷会短暂不可用，可能导致I/O错误</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>卷Dismount/Mount</td>
<td>文件系统层</td>
<td>卷短暂不可用，文件句柄失效</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME / FSCTL_UNLOCK_VOLUME</td>
<td>文件系统层</td>
<td>短暂独占，但影响最小</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>PnP设备事件</td>
<td>即插即用层</td>
<td>不受控，依赖硬件事件</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p>其中，FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME + FSCTL_UNLOCK_VOLUME 是最轻量的方案。<code>FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME</code> 会强制NTFS刷新脏数据并获得独占访问权，随后的 <code>FSCTL_UNLOCK_VOLUME</code> 释放锁时，NTFS会重新从磁盘设备层读取最新属性并更新VCB缓存。这个过程不需要卸载卷，也不需要脱机磁盘，对业务的影响最小。</p>
<p>这也就解释了为什么 <code>PowerShell Set-Disk -ReadOnly $true</code> 看起来总能正确生效——它底层调用的是WMI的 <code>MSFT_Disk.SetAttributes</code> 方法（由storagewmi.dll实现），内部大概率封装了Lock/Unlock或者等效的属性刷新逻辑。而直接调用Win32 IOCTL的开发者，则需要自行处理这一层同步。</p>
<h3>解决方案：Lock → SetReadOnly → Unlock</h3>
<p>基于上述原理，正确的Win32只读设置流程应该是三步：</p>
<div class="relative max-w-full mb-[var(--chat-item-gap)] last:mb-0 w-fit">
<div class="relative">
<div class="epitaxy-diff pl-[var(--p8)] py-[var(--p6)] pr-[calc(var(--h3)+var(--p3)*2)] rounded-r6 bg-t1 overflow-clip">
<div data-content="">
<div data-line="1" data-line-type="context" data-line-index="0">FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME → 强制NTFS刷新脏数据，获得独占访问</div>
<div data-line="2" data-line-type="context" data-line-index="1">↓</div>
<div data-line="3" data-line-type="context" data-line-index="2">IOCTL_DISK_SET_DISK_ATTRIBUTES → 设置磁盘只读属性</div>
<div data-line="4" data-line-type="context" data-line-index="3">↓</div>
<div data-line="5" data-line-type="context" data-line-index="4">FSCTL_UNLOCK_VOLUME → 释放锁，NTFS重新加载最新属性到VCB</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>对应的核心代码实现：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;OperateResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SetReadOnlyAsync(
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> volumeGuid, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> diskNumber, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> isReadOnly, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> timeoutSeconds = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step 1: Lock卷 — 触发NTFS刷新脏数据 + 获取独占访问</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> lockResult = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LockVolumeAsync(volumeGuid, timeoutSeconds);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!lockResult.IsResultOk || lockResult.Data ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IntPtr.Zero)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> OperateResult.ToError($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Lock volume failed: {lockResult.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step 2: 设置只读 — 修改磁盘设备层属性</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> setReadOnlyResult = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task.Run(
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SetReadOnly(diskNumber, isReadOnly)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ).TimeOutAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">setReadOnlyResult.Success)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UnlockVolumeAsync(lockResult.Data);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> setReadOnlyResult;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Step 3: Unlock卷 — NTFS重新加载磁盘属性到VCB缓存</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> unlockResult = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UnlockVolumeAsync(lockResult.Data);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">unlockResult.Success)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OperateResult.ToError(
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>             $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SetReadOnly ok but Unlock failed: {unlockResult.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OperateResult.ToSuccess();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>其中 <code>LockVolume</code> 通过卷GUID直接打开设备（如 <code>\\?\Volume{xxx}</code>），调用 <code>FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME</code>。如果遇到 <code>ACCESS_DENIED (0x05)</code> 错误，说明有其他进程持有该卷上的文件句柄，需要加入重试逻辑（建议5次重试，间隔500ms）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> OperateResult&lt;IntPtr&gt; LockVolumeByGuid(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> volumeGuid)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> devicePath = volumeGuid.TrimEnd(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     IntPtr hVolume =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CreateFile(devicePath,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         GENERIC_READ |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GENERIC_WRITE,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         FILE_SHARE_READ |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         IntPtr.Zero, OPEN_EXISTING, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, IntPtr.Zero);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (hVolume ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> OperateResult&lt;IntPtr&gt;.ToWin32Error(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CreateFile failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (DeviceIoControl(hVolume, FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME, ...))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> OperateResult&lt;IntPtr&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.ToSuccess(hVolume);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> err =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    CloseHandle(hVolume);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> OperateResult&lt;IntPtr&gt;.ToWin32Error($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME failed after</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, err);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> }</pre>
</div>
<div>
<p>此外，在磁盘挂载流程中，操作顺序也很关键。应该在分配挂载点（AddAccessPath）之前完成只读设置，因为一旦挂载路径暴露给系统，第三方软件（如杀毒、索引）可能立即打开卷上的文件，导致后续Lock失败。推荐的挂载操作顺序为：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>取消只读 → 扩容 → 设置磁盘标签 → 设置只读 → 分配挂载点</p>
</blockquote>
<p>总结来说，直接使用Win32 IOCTL操作磁盘只读时，必须搭配 <code>FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME</code> / <code>FSCTL_UNLOCK_VOLUME</code> 来同步NTFS文件系统的VCB缓存。这不是一个可选的优化，而是一个必须的处理步骤——缺少它，磁盘设备层和文件系统层的只读状态就会处于未对齐的状态，导致写入行为与预期不符。</p>
</div>

</div>
